title: Hong Kong 100 – Rules
claims: Participants must complete the marked course on foot under their own power.
Participants are required to be semi self-sufficient and must carry their mandatory equipment at all times during the race.
Outside assistance and support crews are only permitted at checkpoints, except in an emergency.
There is no restriction on buying drinks or food from shops, restaurants, hawkers and vending machines along the route.
Pacers and support runners are strictly prohibited.
Refreshments at the checkpoints are reserved for runners only.
Race numbers must be visible at all times on the front of clothing.
A runner who withdraws must inform event officials and sign the withdrawal form at the closest checkpoint, unless assisted from the course by first aid crews.
A runner who needs first aid must use the phone numbers printed on the race bib to contact the organisers.
Runners must stay on the marked course and shortcuts are strictly prohibited.
Random gear checks may be performed, and a participant without mandatory gear may incur a penalty ranging from a time penalty to disqualification.
A runner who misses any cut-off time must withdraw from the race as instructed.
Damaging or disturbing flora or fauna, littering and doping are strictly prohibited.
The organisers may cancel or cut short the event for adverse weather, landslides, rockfalls or hill fires along the course, protests or blockage, or force majeure.
The organisers reserve the right to make changes to the rules, requirements, route and other arrangements.
